name: Combat
description: A weapons workbench and the shield you craft on it. The bench costs a crafting table, 3 logs and 5 iron ingots; the shield 4 planks and 4 iron ingots; an iron sword 2 iron ingots and a stick — or, with the Forge installed, a blade cast from raw iron in a sword blade mould (thrown from clay at the pottery table) and one stick, and the ingot recipe goes away. Hold the use button with the shield in either hand to raise it: monster melee coming at your front is blocked while it is up, you move at half speed, and both hands are committed — no punching, mining or interacting until you lower it. A hit it absorbs knocks it aside for half a second, so a pack of monsters still gets through. Built entirely on the engine's generic body seams — damage cancellation, the speed scale, the barred-action claim, per-hand held poses, rig bone offsets and the server-to-client cue — with every shield rule authored in the mod and predicted client-side. Pickaxes, axes and swords are the pack's too: their swings are authored animations, and a swing lands its hit the instant the animation's impact plays — on every body the tool's strike window reaches from where you are looking then, harder the closer and the more dead-on you are (an axe sweeps, a pickaxe plunges, a sword cuts level and fast — it hits a little softer than an iron axe and swings almost twice as often, chaining a cut, the return cut and a thrust). A bow (3 sticks + 3 rope at the bench) draws while the use button is held — twenty ticks to full, shown through its pull frames, and a full draw held another twenty shakes and looses itself — and looses an arrow (16 per stick and iron ingot) from your pack when you let go: a full draw point-blank hits like a fully augmented iron axe landing dead-on, a barely drawn one falls within a few blocks and hits like a stone shovel, and an arrow that meets a block sticks there to be picked up again. Disable the pack and every hit is the engine's plain click again.
summary: Adds a weapons workbench, a shield that blocks monster melee from the front, an iron sword (cast at the forge when that pack is installed), and a bow with arrows that stick where they land; makes axes, pickaxes and swords land their hits where and when their swings do.
